must: Fence the write: transition UPDATE MUST include a CAS predicate on lock_version/state (optimistic locking is correctness; LOCKS-1 is efficiency).

constraints: State attribute MUST be an enum with explicit allowed values.
Transition actions MUST enforce concurrency via optimistic_lock(:lock_version). LOCKS-1 primitives MAY be used in addition; exemptions MUST NOT disable optimistic fencing.
SM-0 consumers MUST declare a lock_version attribute (integer, non-null, default 1) for optimistic locking.
Stale update concurrency failures MUST map to ERR-1 subcode SM_STALE_RECORD.

subcode_conditions.when: A guard/validation denies a transition based on business predicates.
A requested transition is not permitted from the current state (including terminal-state immutability).
The record is in a state not recognized by the declared state enum.
Optimistic locking detects a stale lock_version during transition attempt.

ordering_guarantees: Outbox events are written transactionally with the transition and processed asynchronously.
replay_and_idempotency: Transition side effects MUST be idempotent via deterministic dedupe keys to support retries.

consistency_guarantees: State changes occur only through explicit transition actions.
No external side effects inside state transitions; use outbox-only patterns.
constitution_mapping: TEN-1: org_id tenant key and hide-existence semantics.
ERR-1: canonical error envelope and stable subcodes.
immutability_rules: Terminal states are treated as immutable for state transitions unless a documented no-op/idempotent policy exists.

terminal_state_model.requirement: Resources claiming SM-0 compliance MUST declare terminal_states explicitly and MUST reject transitions from terminal states unless explicitly whitelisted as idempotent no-op.

migration_backward_compatibility.compat_strategy: Additive-only changes for patch/minor; breaking semantics require major bump.
rolling_deploy_safety: During rolling deploys, transition actions MUST remain compatible with N and N-1 worker/job code paths.

release_blocks: P0 gate failures MUST block release.

trace_id_propagation.where: Fields MUST be present in DP-1 outbox envelope and in logs/traces for every transition and outbox delivery attempt.

never_owns: Subsystem-specific state graphs, domain-specific validation rules, or business workflows.
out_of_scope: Runtime performance benchmarking beyond declared budgets.
Authorization policy design beyond the forbid/require rules declared in this contract.
owns: Normative, enforceable standard for modeling state transitions in Ash 3.x resources using AshStateMachine.

rules.rationale: Prevents drift and makes CI enforcement deterministic.
rules.text: SM-0 and SM-0-GATE MUST be JSON-only normative artifacts; repacks (_r1/_r2) are forbidden; metadata must match filenames and manifest pins.

rules.rationale: Prevents hidden behavior and makes the graph auditable.
rules.text: No wildcards. Every allowed transition MUST be explicitly declared (from → to) and implemented as exactly one Ash action per transition.

rules.rationale: Guarantees invariants, auditability, and consistent error mapping.
rules.text: State changes MUST occur only via transition actions using AshStateMachine.transition_state/2 (or built-in state machine transition changes). Direct updates to the :state attribute are forbidden.

rules.rationale: Stops user-controlled state mutation and makes transitions deterministic.
rules.text: Transition actions MUST NOT accept the :state attribute (accept [] for :state). This restriction applies only to attribute acceptance; it MUST NOT be interpreted as banning action arguments. Transition context MUST be passed via action arguments (e.g., for guard evaluation, audit metadata, and DP-1 outbox payload construction).

Guards MUST be implemented as Ash-native validations/changes that add errors to the changeset. A guard failure MUST result in {:error, %Ash.Error{}} at the action boundary (no arbitrary tuples or maps). Boundary error mapping MUST emit ERR-1 subcode SM_GUARD_FAILED for guard denials, and SM_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED for disallowed transitions.

rules.rationale: Avoids double increment and preserves correct stale-record detection.
rules.text: All state machine resources MUST include lock_version and MUST enable optimistic locking (optimistic_lock(:lock_version) or equivalent). Every transition write MUST be fenced by a Compare-And-Swap predicate (lock_version and/or current state) at the time of UPDATE. LOCKS-1 primitives (e.g., advisory locks) MAY be used for throughput and contention reduction, but MUST NOT replace optimistic fencing for correctness.

rules.rationale: Prevents oversell/over-release and deadlocks under load.
rules.text: When concurrency primitives are required (e.g., transition contention, counters, or cross-resource orchestration), implementations MUST follow LOCKS-1 canonical lock ordering, idempotency, and exemption rules. Only LOCKS-1 is a valid lock/concurrency contract reference for SM-0 consumers.
Authorization MUST always run for transition actions; authorize?: false is forbidden in production paths.

rules.rationale: Enables retries and keeps transitions atomic.
rules.text: External side-effects (notifications, integrations, projections, search indexing, email, webhooks) MUST be performed via DP-1 outbox only. Transition actions MUST persist durable state first, then enqueue DP-1 outbox records transactionally with deterministic dedupe keys. Direct side-effects inside transition actions are forbidden.
Transition events MUST include the standard payload keys defined by this contract.

rules.rationale: Transition audit records support internal audit without adding domain events.
rules.text: A transition audit record is an internal audit record. It MUST be persisted atomically with a successful transition and MUST NOT be represented as an EVT-1 event or outbox event.

data_access_constraints: authorize?: false is forbidden in production paths.

summary: Canonical, enforceable standard for modeling state transitions in Ash 3.x using AshStateMachine. Ensures explicit transitions, deterministic guards, concurrency safety, auditability, and safe side-effects for an enterprise multi-tenant ticketing platform.

tenancy_model.rls_expectations: Fail-closed when tenant context is missing; hide-existence for cross-tenant reads.

title: State Machine Standard (Ash 3.x)

transition_audit.write_rule: Write the transition-audit record atomically with the successful CAS state transition. Do not register or publish it as an EVT-1 event.
